morgan (docs): Hey all 1: opened a PR to merge retention examples, migration checklist, and SDK snippets into a single internal+customer doc. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5699 :wave:
jess (security): Skimmed. Please include both redaction and tokenization/pseudonymization examples, plus a short note about KMS salt rotation and re-identification risk. Avoid ops-level details in the customer summary. :lock:

rafa (legal): Agreed. I'll add a short legal-hold paragraph and a sample exception approval flow. Mark TTLs as illustrative.

kai (eng-docs): I'll add py/ts/ruby snippets. Quick Q: do we want an explicit Ruby tokenization example for platform teams that use Sidekiq consumers?

morgan (docs): Yes, include Ruby. Proposed example TTLs: 14d (short), 90d (medium), 3y (long) labelled as examples only.

jess (security): Also include a migration pattern for teams with raw audit logs: snapshot -> sanitize (redact/pseudo) -> validate queries -> cutover -> expire raw archive per legal. Add CI checks for query parity.

kai (eng-docs): Ruby snippet (illustrative):
```ruby
# illustrative only - call vetted crypto helper in prod
require 'openssl'
def pseudonymize(id, salt)
  OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest('sha256', salt, id)[0..23]
end
```

docs-bot: PR #5699 status: review requested by jess (security), rafa (legal).

morgan (docs): Added reviewer checklist: 1) TTLs appropriate for use-case, 2) SDK snippets call vetted crypto libs, 3) customer summary avoids operational detail, 4) links to infra KMS docs verified.

jess (security): Left two minor nits on the PR: tighten SOC2 phrasing to "retention determined by business need and legal obligations" and add callout that hashing alone is insufficient for high-risk identifiers.

rafa (legal): Posted suggested wording for the external FAQ. Also added an approval step for retention extensions.

morgan (docs): Thanks — aiming to merge after signoffs and will publish a short docs note. If reviewers approve today, I'll schedule a 10m sync to finalize customer FAQ copy. :calendar:
